notes: Left 4 Dead 2 overhaul: removed autoexec.cfg and cleaned engine cvars; added audible sound feedback (ui/helpful_event_1, beep07, error buzzer) to physical H revive key; eliminated bottom-center hint black containers so revive info is strictly on top HUD; fixed 10-20s wipe delay with mp_chattime 1 and immediate round restart when out of revives; resolved Future Rot font rendering on high resolutions by eliminating multi-block resolution fallbacks in clientscheme.res; and fixed Overlord / Super Tank abilities by driving VSLib think timer callbacks every tick.
